name: SM_Dragon_Corpse_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic
tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bakes private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): remains are one-off set pieces
pivot: bbox centre in X/Y, lowest point at z = 0; in Blender +X is screen right and +Y screen up (north) for a yaw_from_sprite row
dresses: the dragon dead on its side as picture 216 shows it: back to the north with the hide still brown and orange, the belly torn open towards the camera with ribs standing over raw muscle and entrails run out on the ground, neck and head along the ground to the west, the long tail curled round from the east to the south, one grey-green wing lying on the ground to the south, the other torn off, flesh thrown around, all of it in a pool of its own blood
known_weaknesses: The hide is the rigged dragon of Unclaimed/dragon (its baked LOD1) posed, laid on the ground bone by bone and cut by rule, so the torn edges follow its triangles and the flesh behind them is one procedural muscle material: no anatomy beyond a rib cage, a backbone and three loops of gut; the raw mass is a displaced union of lumps, not modelled muscle groups. The wing is the flat panel of the source; its folds are a normal map and dark creases. The second wing is simply gone. The pool, the drops and the mist are a flat alpha-tested card 2 cm above the ground. Built to the size of the sprite card (about 2.7 m; the pool card 3.1 m), far smaller than the living dragon of the source (6.7 m). Static, as the sprite.
derived_from: Unclaimed/dragon/Dragon (SK_Dragon_PR, LOD1), posed, cut and baked again with the gore
gore_in_mesh: torn hide with flesh rims, carcass core, raw muscle mass, ribs, backbone, entrails, thrown chunks; pool card with drops and mist (no companion decal)
layout: as picture 216 (+X screen right, +Y north): the 216 row needs no turn, the 212 row turns it half round
lod_build: Unclaimed/tools/bl.sh ../../Corpses/tools/fbx_lods.py Dragon_Corpse (after the build; no rebake)
